name: Canonical prayer-book style
description: The house style both member books already wear. Style = presentation only; never content. Future: save additional style packs here (owner or reader) and set thesis.style — the pipeline, anatomy and gates stay identical, only the look changes.

type_stack.devanagari: Tiro Devanagari Sanskrit (OFL, fonts/ in book dir)
type_stack.latin: Cormorant Garamond variable (OFL, fonts/ in book dir)
type_stack.note: Devanagari always transliterated from IAST at build; never hand bytes

render: chrome print-to-pdf of bookkit HTML (prints/bookkit/engine.py); gate prints/kdp_preflight.py

cover.note: the paperback cover is its own house style pack: styles/cover-canonical.json — black ground, ivory type, fixed geometry, Svatantrya logo always centred small on the back
cover.front_emblem: per book (book.json meta.cover_image); auto-inverted to white-ink at build
